title: Frame
description: ABRA wire contract (VIEW-AGNOSTIC). The discriminated union of every frame on the wire: 7 participant messages + 3 hub frames + the JOIN handshake. NO ops — durable change is declarative `content`/`presentation` patches the reducer merges (per INTERACTION_RECONCILE). View-set-dependent parts stay permissive and are validated against per-view manifests (in abra-views): `view` (no closed enum), `CanvasEvent.value` (per-view value object), `content`/`presentation` (per-view shape), and the `action`/`kind` keys of `config.actions`/`highlight`.

Source.title: Source
Source.description: A participant identity: a human (`user`, or `user:<id>` to distinguish concurrent humans / browser tabs) or an agent (`agent:<id>`).

AgentSource.title: AgentSource
AgentSource.description: An agent identity (used for `owner`; unlike Source it never admits `user`).

Path.title: Path
Path.description: Element address `<elementType>/<seg>[/<seg>...]`, slash-delimited. Per-view arity (node/edge/row/cell/col/range) is set by each view's manifest; here it is a generic string.

EventValue.title: EventValue
EventValue.description: The value a CANVAS_EVENT carries. On the action branch it is a per-view named value object (a position for reposition_node, a cell edit for edit_cell, ...); on the control branch it is a Scalar. The schema keeps it permissive; the reducer validates the value per view against the catalogue's signature (type, keys, enums, referenced elements).

Content.title: Content
Content.description: Per-view content. Collection keys (nodes/edges/rows/...) are id-keyed maps that merge per the content-merge rule (element-keyed, shallow within an element, null deletes); the per-view shapes are declared in the view catalogue (abra-views catalogue.json).

Presentation.title: Presentation
Presentation.description: Mutable render params; intentionally untyped in V1 (a view-specific bag merged via declarative presentation patches — encoding, positions, layout, colorBy, filter, …).

ActionBinding.title: ActionBinding
ActionBinding.description: Agent-authored per-action binding at CREATE (immutable). Every published action MUST include `meaning` (task / UX sense). Optional `label`. Whether the action is a consequence (owner-resolved pending) or a local_effect is a STRUCTURAL fact of the view — declared in the view manifest (`catalogue.json`), not chosen here. View-owned local_effects, broadcasts, and dwell also live in the manifest (`actionPresentation.json`), not here.

default.description: whether the view's BUILT-IN affordance for this action (its default chrome / gesture — e.g. the add-column slot, the column-header sort) is shown. Omitted ⇒ true. Set false to suppress the default chrome and drive the action ONLY from a config.controls widget (CONTROLLER_ONLY); leave true to offer both the chrome AND a control (DEFAULT_CONTROLLER), which stay in sync via shared state.

actions.description: Per-action map keyed by the view's action strings (the closed set in the view's manifest). Immutable substrate.

Control.title: Control
Control.description: Agent-composed toolbar widget (config.controls). All controls share the base fields below; `options` is `select`-only and `min`/`max`/`step` are `slider`-only. A control does ONE of `fires` / `writes`.

type.description: button = one-shot trigger · select = pick one of `options` · switch = boolean toggle · slider = a number in [min,max] · text = freeform string input

fires.description: id of a PUBLISHED action this control fires (a config.actions key); its `value` becomes the action value. Invokes the action exactly like the built-in chrome does — if that action is a structural consequence it mints the same pending. Mutually exclusive with `writes`.

writes.description: a config.presentation key this control sets directly (a raw render knob with NO action, e.g. encoding). Firing patches config.presentation[writes] = value (ungated). Mutually exclusive with `fires`.

value.description: initial / default value the control emits

Highlight.title: Highlight
Highlight.description: Source- and kind-keyed coordination overlay: highlight[joinKey][source][kind] = {paths}. joinKey = ref ?? element-id; kind is the agent-/view-chosen channel (coordination, message-ref, …), styled client-side. Distinct sources and kinds compose; `paths: []` (or a null leaf) clears.

AppliedEffects.title: AppliedEffects
AppliedEffects.description: Agent-applied local_effects (shared because an agent has no view of its own): appliedEffects[joinKey][source] = {effects}. The local_effect compositor renders these exactly like a user's client-local local_effects. joinKey = ref ?? element-id; `effects: []` (or a null leaf) clears.

Canvas.title: Canvas
Canvas.description: Full canvas object as carried in SNAPSHOT.

view.description: view-type id: one of the shipped views (graph, table, text, display); not a closed enum in the schema
view-type id: one of the shipped views (graph, table, text, display); not a closed enum in the schema

CanvasEvent.title: CanvasEvent
CanvasEvent.description: A gesture (action) XOR a control activation. Source-agnostic (user or agent via fire_action).

action.description: view action id; one of the actions in the view's manifest

config.description: OPTIONAL — a presentation-only op payload (config.presentation patch). The server merges it into config.presentation (ungated, like a presentation op). This is how a USER's presentation gesture (collapse/reorder/layout/filter) travels — the user emits only CANVAS_EVENT; UPDATE_CANVAS is agent-only.

reqId.description: OPTIONAL — present only for an agent fire_action

canvases.description: all open canvases keyed by canvasId

Join.title: Join
Join.description: Pre-session transport handshake (not an 8th state message). Hub validates connectToken, binds the unspoofable source, replies SNAPSHOT or ERROR.
